Explain the example for update data without making a new chart

blocks.text: A chart instance can receive changed data. Calling update redraws it from the new values.
Use a browser project with Chart.js 4 installed. Each example creates its own canvas inside a sized holder. Package imports need your project build tool and do not run in this playground.

blocks.title: Update data without making a new chart

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `createElement` makes a new element in memory. Append it to the document when you want it to appear.
`dataset` reads `data-...` attributes as text values. Convert a numeric value explicitly before doing arithmetic.
`chart.update()` redraws after your chosen data or option changes have been applied.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Changing an array alone is not the complete redraw step. Call update after the intended changes.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Add a label and matching data value, then update.
